name: X-linked Thrombocytopenia with Thalassemia

criteria.description: Persistent thrombocytopenia with platelet counts typically below 100,000/µL
Presence of microcytic hypochromic anemia consistent with thalassemia
Identification of pathogenic mutations in the GATA1 gene on the X chromosome
Bone marrow showing dysmegakaryopoiesis with reduced platelet production
X-linked inheritance pattern with affected male relatives

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of thrombocytopenia and thalassemia phenotype with confirmed GATA1 mutation
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis is supported by clinical, hematological, and genetic findings; bone marrow biopsy may aid but is not mandatory.

laboratory: Microcytic hypochromic anemia with low MCV and MCH
Peripheral blood smear showing anisopoikilocytosis and target cells
imaging: Possible skeletal changes on X-ray consistent with thalassemia
genetic: Pathogenic mutations in GATA1 gene (X chromosome)
X-linked inheritance confirmed by family genetic studies
other: Bone marrow biopsy showing dysmegakaryopoiesis and erythroid hyperplasia

redFlags: Severe bleeding episodes including intracranial hemorrhage
Family history of early male deaths from bleeding complications
